summary.text: Kris Mayes is the incumbent Democratic Attorney General, a former journalist and law professor who served as a Republican on the Arizona Corporation Commission from 2003 to 2010 and was elected in 2022. Her campaign highlights drug and fentanyl prosecutions, Medicaid-fraud enforcement, consumer-protection suits and federal litigation.

paragraphs.text: Grew up in Prescott; began her career as a journalist and served in the Napolitano administration.
Served on the Arizona Corporation Commission as a Republican from 2003 to 2010.
Elected Attorney General in 2022 by a margin of 280 votes.
